name: Menger Sponge Fractal Generation
definition: Generates a 3D voxel grid representing a Menger sponge by iteratively dividing space into 3x3x3 subcubes and removing those where two or more coordinates fall into the middle third.
summary: Menger Sponge Fractal Generation creates 3D representations via iterative subdivision and axis-aligned box subtraction, distinguishing itself from Mandelbulb methods by using discrete coordinate modulo arithmetic.
